_schema_info.name: PMEGP Document Metadata Schema
_schema_info.description: Standardized metadata format for all PMEGP-related documents in this archive. Every document MUST have a corresponding JSON file with these fields.

document_id.description: Unique identifier. Format: PMEGP-AP-YYYY-NNN. Year = year of issue, NNN = sequential number within that year across all categories.

title.description: Full official title of the document as it appears on the document itself. Preserve original capitalization.

date_issued.description: Date the document was officially issued, in YYYY-MM-DD format. If only month/year is known, use YYYY-MM-01.

issuing_authority.description: Full name of the issuing authority. Examples: 'Commissioner of Industries, Andhra Pradesh', 'KVIC Regional Office, Vijayawada', 'District Collector, Anantapur'.

category.description: Category code mapping to the folder structure: 01=AP Govt GOs, 02=KVIC Letters, 03=Commissioner Proceedings, 04=DIC Proceedings, 05=Collector Proceedings, 06=SLBC/DLCC, 07=Miscellaneous.

sub_category.description: Specific document type within the broader category.

district.description: Name of the relevant district if the document is district-specific. Use null for state-level or national-level documents. Must match the official district name from the AP districts list.

subject_keywords.description: Searchable keywords that describe the document's subject matter. Include both English and transliterated Telugu terms where relevant. Examples: ['subsidy', 'margin_money', 'target_allocation', 'application_deadline'].

source_url.description: Original URL where the document was found. Use null if obtained via RTI, physical collection, or offline source.

file_path.description: Relative path to the document file within this repository. Should start with the category folder name. Example: '01_ap_government_gos_and_circulars/PMEGP-AP-2024-001_subsidy_rate_revision.pdf'.

language.description: Primary language of the document: 'en' for English, 'te' for Telugu, 'bilingual' for documents containing both languages.

pages.description: Total number of pages in the document.

file_size_kb.description: File size in kilobytes. Optional but recommended for tracking archive growth.

ocr_status.description: OCR processing status. 'original' = native digital PDF (text already selectable), 'ocr_done' = OCR processing completed, 'needs_manual_review' = OCR output has errors, 'not_applicable' = non-scanned document (HTML, text).

notes.description: Additional context: why this document is significant, related document IDs, discrepancies in the original, etc.

related_document_ids.description: List of other document_ids in this archive that are directly related (e.g., a GO and its implementing circular, or a letter and its reply).

collected_by.description: Name or username of the person who collected and uploaded this document.

date_uploaded.description: Date this document was added to the archive, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

verification_status.description: Whether the document has been verified against the original source. 'verified' = confirmed match, 'unverified' = not yet checked, 'disputed' = content or authenticity concerns raised.
